flatten_action_to_string: use OrdersFlattener to convert a Diplomacy Action tuple into a semicolon-separated order string
flatten_joint_action_to_string: use OrdersFlattener to convert a JointAction dict into a multi-line string with all powers orders
unflatten_action_from_string: use OrdersUnflattener to parse a semicolon-separated order string back into an Action tuple
unflatten_rollout_joint_action: use OrdersUnflattener to parse a multi-phase rollout joint action string into a RolloutJointAction dict
build_order_history_dict: use build_order_history_dct to extract all previous phase orders from a game JSON up to the current phase
